Trace, implement and test: Even Odd Digits Sum

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
public class EvenOddDigitsSum {
    public static int evenOddDigitsSum(int input1, String input2) {
        int evenSum = 0;
        int totalSum = 0;

        while (input1 != 0) {
            int digit = input1 % 10;
            totalSum += digit;
            if (digit % 2 == 0) evenSum += digit;
            input1 /= 10;
        }

        if (input2.equals("even")) return evenSum;
        else return totalSum - evenSum;
    }
}
